_readme: The literature library: spec sheets, safety data, price list, photography
and point-of-sale material. Every trade buyer asks for these before they
stock anything, so they are listed whether or not the file exists yet.
An item with `file` set renders as a download. An item with `file: null`
renders as 'Available on request' and links to AragoCor's contact form with
the document named in the query string, so the request reaches a person
instead of a 404. Drop a PDF into assets/literature/ and set `file` to its
NOTHING IN assets/literature/ EXISTS YET. Every `file` below is null on
purpose. That is the honest state: the documents have not been produced.
group     which section the row appears under
kind      shown as the small label on the row
format    PDF, ZIP, XLSX — shown in the meta line
pages     optional, shown in the meta line
audience  'trade' rows are hidden from the public product page
note      one line under the title
